verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a REST Developer API with a Transactions API. Probe-6 confirms a live OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, including /developer/v1/transactions. The API uses OAuth 2.0 (client credentials, authorization code, refresh) with granular resource:permission scopes such as transactions:read and least-privilege guidance. Missing for 10: explicit REST endpoint evidence for retrieving receipts and reimbursements/expenses (shown only via CLI/MCP scopes such as receipts:write and reimbursements:read), and independent developer corroboration of pulling that data.
